datasets.title: NBER Patent Data Project — patents and citations
datasets.description: Historical U.S. patent records, citations, technology classifications and assignee identifiers for studying innovation and knowledge flows.
notes: The author-hosted page provides historical files and cautions that some are interim or not completely cleaned. Follow its project link for documentation and later releases.
The public patent files are not the cited paper's complete replication package: the study also combines other sources, including restricted financial data.
datasets.verification: Provider documentation read; both ZIP endpoints returned HTTP 200 to HEAD requests on 2026-10-16. Full archives were not downloaded.

datasets.title: PatentsView — disambiguated U.S. patent data
datasets.description: Research-ready U.S. patent data linking inventors, organizations and locations for studying invention, technological change and firm innovation.
notes: PatentsView migrated to the USPTO Open Data Portal in March 2026. The current portal requires a USPTO.gov account; API access requires a key.
Official documentation lists releases through December 2025. Coverage depends on the chosen table; inspect its release notes and data dictionary.
This specific research-ready collection is distinct from the existing general USPTO portal listing. Other sources used in the paper may require subscriptions.
datasets.verification: Official USPTO documentation read; the product page returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-16. Registration-gated files were not downloaded.

datasets.title: USPTO Trademark Case Files
datasets.description: Trademark applications and registrations with ownership, product classes and prosecution and renewal histories, useful for studying product introductions and innovation.
notes: The paper explicitly uses the 1970–2015 trademark files. The current provider release extends through March 2024; it is not the identical historical extract.
The paper also uses subscription financial databases; this entry covers its public trademark component.
USPTO downloads use temporary signed URLs through the Open Data Portal. Account requirements apply; full archives were not downloaded.
datasets.verification: Official dataset documentation and its linked download product opened successfully on 2026-10-16. Publisher PDF Section 3.1 explicitly identifies the dataset. No claim of unrestricted access to the complete study data.

datasets.title: Business Dynamics Statistics (BDS)
datasets.description: Public annual statistics on firm startups, establishment entry and exit, employment and job flows, with breakdowns by firm age, size, industry and geography.
notes: Existing library entry enriched with a verified research citation and tags on 16 October 2026.

The cited paper uses public BDS statistics for Figure 1, drawn from the 2019 release. Its main analysis uses restricted Annual Survey of Manufactures and Longitudinal Business Database records; those are not included here.
This link provides the 2023 release, covering 1978–2023. Release coverage differs from the historical extract used in the paper.
datasets.verification: Official data portal and release directory opened successfully. The firm-age CSV returned HTTP 200 and text/csv; its header and first data row were inspected. Publisher Figure 1 explicitly names this dataset.
